profile.summary: Attendly is a company that makes software for managing after-school programs in California. Its platform handles program registration, attendance tracking, and state and federal reporting, including reporting for the Expanded Learning Opportunities Program (ELOP).

review.notes: Attendly's privacy policy names Attendly, Inc. at 2120 University Ave., Berkeley, CA, matching the agenda name and city. Its site describes ELOP-focused after-school software and quotes an Oakland USD site coordinator, which fits the contract purpose. The summary, website, generic hello@ email and address are all supported. The Curacubby agreement was not verified, but it doesn't affect the Attendly profile.
